north.evidence: Mackay 1943 Plate IV (PDF page 368 of research/literature/sources/mackay_1943_chandaro.pdf), 'CHANHU-DARO: MOUND II HARAPPA II LEVEL': compass needle with the words 'MAG. NORTH NOV. 2ND 1935' along it, letters S and N at its ends and W and E on the cross through its circle, at the lower right of the plate. The same compass inscription is recorded for Plates II and III in the plan library.
north.survey_year_note: 2 November 1935 as a decimal year (day 306 of 365)

scale.note: Ticks 0 and 40 FEET of the vertical scale bar; 40 ft = 12.192 m
